cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(CyMCPSDK VERSION 0.7.1 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP "Build HTTP and HTTPS transport" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_PLATFORM "Build native process adapter" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_MCP "Build MCP server and client" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_AI "Build AI connectors and conversation service" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_LOCAL "Build local engine and dependency manager" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build headless example application" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_TESTS "Build offline tests" ON)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_BENCHMARKS "Build native dispatch microbenchmark" OFF)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_CHAT_UI "Build the optional native CyUI chat panel" OFF)
option(CYMCP_BUILD_CHAT_APP "Build the Windows chat test application" OFF)
set(CYMCP_CYUI_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "CyUI source checkout (or provide CyUI::DocumentViews before adding this project)")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(cymcp_json INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(cymcp_json SYSTEM INTERFACE $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
set_target_properties(cymcp_json PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME Json)
set(cymcp_targets cymcp_json)
function(cymcp_module target alias)
  add_library(${target} STATIC ${ARGN})
  add_library(CyMCP::${alias} ALIAS ${target})
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME ${alias} POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  target_compile_features(${target} PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
  target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
  target_link_libraries(${target} PUBLIC cymcp_json Threads::Threads)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4 /permissive- /utf-8)
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
  else()
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
  endif()
endfunction()
cymcp_module(cymcp_core Core src/core.cpp src/schema.cpp src/security.cpp src/resources.cpp src/performance.cpp src/changes.cpp)
target_include_directories(cymcp_core PRIVATE third_party/picosha2)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_core PRIVATE bcrypt advapi32)
endif()
list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_core)
if(CYMCP_BUILD_PLATFORM)
  cymcp_module(cymcp_platform Platform src/process.cpp src/search.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_platform PUBLIC cymcp_core)
  list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_platform)
elseif(CYMCP_BUILD_MCP OR CYMCP_BUILD_AI OR CYMCP_BUILD_LOCAL)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "MCP, AI and Local modules require CYMCP_BUILD_PLATFORM")
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP)
  cymcp_module(cymcp_http Http src/http.cpp src/app.cpp)
  target_include_directories(cymcp_http SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_http PUBLIC cymcp_core)
  if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_http PRIVATE winhttp ws2_32 crypt32)
  else()
    find_package(CURL REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_http PRIVATE CURL::libcurl)
  endif()
  list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_http)
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_MCP)
  cymcp_module(cymcp_mcp MCP src/mcp.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_mcp PUBLIC cymcp_platform)
  if(CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_mcp PUBLIC cymcp_http)
    target_compile_definitions(cymcp_mcp PUBLIC CYMCP_HAS_HTTP=1)
  endif()
  list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_mcp)
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_AI OR CYMCP_BUILD_LOCAL)
  if(NOT CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "AI and Local modules require CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP")
  endif()
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_AI)
  cymcp_module(cymcp_ai AI src/ai.cpp src/context.cpp src/content.cpp src/conversation_store.cpp src/codex.cpp src/claude.cpp src/agent_cli.cpp src/acp.cpp src/api.cpp src/providers.cpp src/discovery.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_ai PUBLIC cymcp_http cymcp_platform)
  list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_ai)
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_LOCAL)
  cymcp_module(cymcp_local Local src/local.cpp src/dependencies.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_local PUBLIC cymcp_http cymcp_platform)
  list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_local)
endif()
add_library(cymcp_sdk INTERFACE)
add_library(CyMCP::SDK ALIAS cymcp_sdk)
set_target_properties(cymcp_sdk PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME SDK)
target_link_libraries(cymcp_sdk INTERFACE ${cymcp_targets})
list(APPEND cymcp_targets cymcp_sdk)
if(CYMCP_BUILD_EXAMPLES AND CYMCP_BUILD_MCP)
  add_executable(cymcp_example examples/app.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_example PRIVATE CyMCP::SDK)
  install(TARGETS cymcp_example RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_EXAMPLES AND CYMCP_BUILD_AI)
  add_executable(cymcp_chat examples/chat.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_chat PRIVATE CyMCP::AI)
  install(TARGETS cymcp_chat RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
  install(FILES examples/chat-ollama.json examples/chat-openai.json examples/chat-devin.json examples/chat-acp.json examples/chat-opencode.json examples/chat-claude.json DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/examples)
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(cymcp_core_tests tests/core_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_core_tests PRIVATE cymcp_core)
  add_test(NAME core COMMAND cymcp_core_tests)
  add_executable(cymcp_resource_tests tests/resources_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_resource_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::Core)
  target_compile_options(cymcp_resource_tests PRIVATE $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>)
  add_test(NAME resources COMMAND cymcp_resource_tests)
  add_executable(cymcp_optional_core_tests tests/optional_core_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_optional_core_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::Core)
  target_compile_options(cymcp_optional_core_tests PRIVATE $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>)
  add_test(NAME optional_core COMMAND cymcp_optional_core_tests)
  set_tests_properties(optional_core PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 45)
  set_tests_properties(resources PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 45)
  if(CYMCP_BUILD_LOCAL)
    add_executable(cymcp_cuda_tests tests/cuda_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_cuda_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_cuda_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::Local)
    add_test(NAME cuda_runtime COMMAND cymcp_cuda_tests "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" $<TARGET_FILE:cymcp_fixture>)
    set_tests_properties(cuda_runtime PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
  endif()
  add_executable(cymcp_fixture tests/fixture.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_fixture PRIVATE cymcp_core)
  if(CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_fixture SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_compile_definitions(cymcp_fixture PRIVATE CYMCP_FIXTURE_HTTP=1)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_fixture PRIVATE cymcp_http)
  endif()
  if(CYMCP_BUILD_MCP AND CYMCP_BUILD_HTTP)
    add_executable(cymcp_notification_tests tests/notifications_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_notification_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::MCP)
    add_test(NAME notifications COMMAND cymcp_notification_tests)
    set_tests_properties(notifications PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 45)
    add_executable(cymcp_mcp_optimization_tests tests/mcp_optimization_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_mcp_optimization_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::MCP)
    target_compile_options(cymcp_mcp_optimization_tests PRIVATE $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>)
    add_test(NAME mcp_optimization COMMAND cymcp_mcp_optimization_tests)
    set_tests_properties(mcp_optimization PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
    add_executable(cymcp_mcp_transport_tests tests/mcp_transport_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_mcp_transport_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_mcp_transport_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::MCP)
    add_test(NAME mcp_transport COMMAND cymcp_mcp_transport_tests)
    set_tests_properties(mcp_transport PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 45)
  endif()
  if(CYMCP_BUILD_MCP AND CYMCP_BUILD_AI AND CYMCP_BUILD_LOCAL)
    add_executable(cymcp_integration_tests tests/integration_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_integration_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_integration_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::SDK)
    add_test(NAME integration COMMAND cymcp_integration_tests $<TARGET_FILE:cymcp_fixture>)
    set_tests_properties(integration PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
  endif()
  if(CYMCP_BUILD_AI)
    add_executable(cymcp_context_tests tests/context_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_context_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_context_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::AI)
    add_test(NAME context COMMAND cymcp_context_tests)
    set_tests_properties(context PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 45)
    add_executable(cymcp_provider_tests tests/providers_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_provider_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_provider_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::AI)
    if(MSVC)
      target_compile_options(cymcp_provider_tests PRIVATE /utf-8)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME providers COMMAND cymcp_provider_tests $<TARGET_FILE:cymcp_fixture>)
    set_tests_properties(providers PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
    add_executable(cymcp_discovery_tests tests/discovery_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_discovery_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_discovery_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::AI)
    target_compile_options(cymcp_discovery_tests PRIVATE $<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>)
    add_test(NAME discovery COMMAND cymcp_discovery_tests $<TARGET_FILE:cymcp_fixture>)
    set_tests_properties(discovery PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    add_executable(cymcp_extension_tests tests/extension_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_extension_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::AI)
    if(MSVC)
      target_compile_options(cymcp_extension_tests PRIVATE /utf-8)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME extensions COMMAND cymcp_extension_tests $<TARGET_FILE:cymcp_fixture>)
    set_tests_properties(extensions PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
    add_executable(cymcp_conversation_tests tests/conversation_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cymcp_conversation_tests SYSTEM PRIVATE third_party/httplib)
    target_link_libraries(cymcp_conversation_tests PRIVATE CyMCP::AI)
    if(MSVC)
      target_compile_options(cymcp_conversation_tests PRIVATE /utf-8)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME conversations COMMAND cymcp_conversation_tests $<TARGET_FILE:cymcp_fixture>)
    set_tests_properties(conversations PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
  endif()
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_BENCHMARKS)
  add_executable(cymcp_benchmark benchmarks/dispatch.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cymcp_benchmark PRIVATE CyMCP::Core)
endif()
if(CYMCP_BUILD_CHAT_UI OR CYMCP_BUILD_CHAT_APP)
  include(cmake/ChatUI.cmake)
endif()
install(TARGETS ${cymcp_targets} EXPORT CyMCPSDKTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(DIRECTORY third_party/nlohmann DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR} FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.hpp")
install(FILES LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK)
install(FILES README.md README.fr.md VERSION.md VERSION.fr.md DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK)
install(DIRECTORY Documentation DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK)
install(DIRECTORY assets DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK)
install(FILES third_party/nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/third_party/nlohmann)
install(FILES third_party/httplib/LICENSE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/third_party/httplib)
install(FILES third_party/picosha2/LICENSE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/third_party/picosha2)
install(DIRECTORY Docs/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/Docs)
install(FILES third_party/nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/licenses RENAME nlohmann-MIT.txt)
install(FILES third_party/httplib/LICENSE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/licenses RENAME httplib-MIT.txt)
install(FILES third_party/picosha2/LICENSE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/CyMCPSDK/licenses RENAME picosha2-MIT.txt)
install(EXPORT CyMCPSDKTargets NAMESPACE CyMCP:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/CyMCPSDK)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/CyMCPSDKConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CyMCPSDKConfig.cmake INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/CyMCPSDK)
write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CyMCPSDKConfigVersion.cmake VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CyMCPSDKConfig.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CyMCPSDKConfigVersion.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/CyMCPSDK)
